stories.headline: Zelensky says Starshield speed cap is back, letting Russian jet drones slip past interceptors

key_facts.fact: On November 12, 2026, Zelensky said Ukrainian units had recorded significant disruptions to Starshield, SpaceX's military version of Starlink, for several days along the entire front line and in occupied territories.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine's military is once again experiencing significant disruptions to the Starshield satellite communications system, the militarized version of Starlink, for several days, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 12.

key_facts.fact: The restrictions cut connectivity for equipment moving faster than 161 km/h (100 mph), and Zelensky said they were 'not random errors but systematic speed restrictions'.
key_facts.excerpt: "Specifically, systematic speed restrictions are being imposed on Starshield, limiting it to 161 kilometers per hour (100 miles per hour)," Zelenskyy wrote on X. He said Ukraine's military had investigated the disruptions and concluded they were not random technical errors but systematic restrictions.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said some Russian strikes had already got through because interceptors could not reach the speed needed to catch Russian jet-powered drones; the Geran-4 typically flies at 300-400 km/h.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy said the renewed cap is primarily disrupting efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. The Geran-4, for example, typically flies at 300–400 kilometers per hour (185–250 miles per hour), according to Ukraine's Defense Intelligence.

key_facts.fact: The cap returned less than three weeks after Ukraine's Defense Ministry said on October 24 that connectivity had been restored at speeds above 400 km/h, following a first cap recorded on October 13-14.
key_facts.excerpt: On 24 October, Ukraine's Defence Ministry confirmed that connectivity had been restored, with stable connections at speeds exceeding 400 kilometres per hour. The restrictions were first recorded overnight on 13–14 October

key_facts.fact: Neither Washington nor SpaceX has accepted responsibility; Musk has said Starshield systems are 'owned and controlled by the US government', and Kyiv says it is trying to establish the circumstances with the US.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk said decisions over Starshield speed restrictions were made by the US military and ultimately the US president, writing on X that "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government." Neither Washington nor SpaceX have publicly accepted responsibility

key_facts.fact: Senior Ukrainian officials told the FT they believe the restrictions were imposed to pressure Kyiv during the latest peace talks with Russia.
key_facts.excerpt: Senior Ukrainian officials told @FT they believed the Starshield speed restrictions were imposed in an effort to pressure Kyiv during the latest peace talks with Russia.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's agreement with Washington for Starshield access expires in mid-2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The renewed disruptions come as Kyiv seeks to extend its agreement with Washington for access to Starshield, which is set to expire in mid-2027.

stories.headline: Witkoff and Kushner meet Putin in Kremlin after Abu Dhabi talks, next brief Zelensky in Dublin

key_facts.fact: Putin's meeting with US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner began in the Kremlin on November 12, 2026, according to the Kremlin.
key_facts.excerpt: В Кремле началась встреча Владимира Путина со специальным посланником Президента Соединённых Штатов Америки Стивеном Уиткоффом и предпринимателем Джаредом Кушнером. 12 ноября 2026 года

key_facts.fact: The envoys' motorcade arrived at the Kremlin shortly after 1pm Moscow time (10:00 GMT); they will then fly to Dublin to brief Zelensky, who is meeting European leaders there.
key_facts.excerpt: An AFP journalist saw the pair's motorcade arrive at the Kremlin shortly after 1:00 pm (1000 GMT). ... will fly to Dublin after meeting Putin to brief his Ukrainian counterpart, Volodymyr Zelensky, who was in the Irish capital to meet with European leaders.

key_facts.fact: Kremlin aides Vladimir Medinsky, Kirill Dmitriev and Yuri Ushakov joined the meeting; Russian media reported Putin thanked Trump for organising Russia-Ukraine contacts and said progress had been made on the humanitarian track.
key_facts.excerpt: putin asked Witkoff and Kushner to convey his thanks to Trump for organizing contacts between russia and Ukraine. At the meeting with the U.S. envoys, putin reportedly emphasized that progress had been made on the humanitarian track ... medinsky, kirill dmitriev and yuri ushakov are reportedly taking part

key_facts.fact: Kushner wrote that the US had aligned with Ukraine and European partners on proposals to put to Putin, while acknowledging that 'significant differences remain'.
key_facts.excerpt: "In close coordination with Ukraine and our European partners, we have aligned on proposals we will discuss with President Putin in Moscow tomorrow, followed by consultations with President Zelenskyy," Kushner wrote, though acknowledged that "significant differences remain"

key_facts.fact: Kushner said he and Witkoff would ask Putin to 'give his blessing' to bringing European representatives into future talks, which Russia has opposed.
key_facts.excerpt: Kushner said he and Witkoff would ask Putin to "give his blessing" to invite European representatives in future discussions ... But the Russians have been opposed to the idea

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said in Dublin there could be a 'window of opportunity' to end the war before 2027: 'the Americans flew to Putin with specifics. I would very much like them to return to Dublin with specifics.'
key_facts.excerpt: Arriving in Ireland late Wednesday, Zelensky also said there could be a "window of opportunity" to end the war with Russia before 2027. "What's important is that the Americans flew to Putin with specifics. I would very much like them to return to Dublin with specifics,"

stories.headline: Ukraine-born drone maker Uforce raises $700M at $6B, with UK wealth fund's largest defense bet

key_facts.fact: Uforce, founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, announced on November 12, 2026 a $700 million Series A at a $6 billion valuation, co-led by Valor Equity Partners and the UK National Wealth Fund.
key_facts.excerpt: UFORCE, a defence-technology company founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, with major hubs in Kyiv and Washington, DC, today announced a $700 million Series A financing round at a valuation of $6 billion.

key_facts.fact: The National Wealth Fund put in $150 million, its largest defense investment, making Uforce the UK's most valuable defense startup; Valor is run by Musk ally Antonio Gracias.
key_facts.excerpt: The UK National Wealth Fund made its largest defense investment ... Valor Equity Partners, an investment firm run by Elon Musk ally Antonio Gracias ... The financing, including $150 million from the NWF, gives London-based Uforce a valuation of $6 billion, making it the UK's most valuable defense startup.

key_facts.fact: The valuation is about six times the roughly $1 billion at which Uforce raised $50 million in March; CEO Oleg Rogynskyy said bookings more than doubled over the past year from a base of several hundred million dollars.
key_facts.excerpt: UFORCE ... raised $50 million at a valuation of around $1 billion in March. ... UFORCE CEO Oleg Rogynskyy told CNBC that the company's bookings have more than doubled over the past year, from a base of several hundred million dollars

key_facts.fact: The U.S.-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund also participated, and former NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe Gen. Christopher Cavoli joins the board.
key_facts.excerpt: with participation from the U.S.-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund. ... General (Ret.) Christopher G. Cavoli, former NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe and Partner at Valor Equity Partners, joins the UFORCE board.

key_facts.fact: Uforce says its Nemesis drones have flown more than 300,000 combat flights and its Magura naval drones helped destroy more than a dozen Russian warships in the Black Sea.
key_facts.excerpt: UFORCE says its NEMESIS drones have completed more than 300,000 combat flights, while its MAGURA naval vessels have contributed to the destruction of more than a dozen Russian warships in the Black Sea.

key_facts.fact: The money will scale manufacturing in Ukraine and allied countries across the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.
key_facts.excerpt: The company plans to use the new funding to scale manufacturing in Ukraine and in allied countries, including the U.S., Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.

key_facts.fact: Defense startups across NATO and allied countries raised $27.1 billion through September 2026, nearly double the total for all of 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Startups across NATO and allied countries raised $27.1 billion through September, nearly double the total for all of 2025, according to an October report from Dealroom and Resilience Media.

stories.headline: Yen nears 160 per dollar as Fed hike bets lift the dollar; Tokyo warns of renewed intervention

key_facts.fact: The dollar rose to 159.94 yen early on November 12, its strongest in more than two months, driven by bets on Fed rate hikes after hot US inflation data.
key_facts.excerpt: The dollar rose to 159.94 against the Japanese yen early on Thursday, hitting its strongest in more than two months, buoyed by growing expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates after hot US inflation data

key_facts.fact: Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said recent moves were too fast and that it is 'too early to forget' the summer intervention, his first FX remarks since late September.
key_facts.excerpt: In his first remarks on foreign exchange since late September, Mimura said he believed recent currency moves have been excessively rapid. "It's still too early to forget what happened this summer,"

key_facts.fact: Japan spent a record 15.4 trillion yen on interventions over three days between July 30 and August 3, including one run jointly with the US, when the yen neared 164 per dollar.
key_facts.excerpt: Japan last conducted interventions on three days between July 30 and August 3, spending a record total of 15.4 trillion yen over the month, as the Japanese currency reached its weakest levels in 40 years near 164 per dollar.

key_facts.fact: Japan's yen-based import price index jumped 24.8% year on year in October.
key_facts.excerpt: The yen-based import price index jumped 24.8% in October from a year earlier, data showed on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: The US dollar index reached 103.08, its highest since April 2025; markets fully price a December Fed hike, with a small chance of 50 basis points.
key_facts.excerpt: The US Dollar Index (DXY) ... trades near 102.88 after reaching 103.08, its highest level since April 2025. Traders now fully price in a December Fed rate hike, with a 25-basis-point (bps) move the most likely outcome and a small chance of a larger 50 bps increase.

key_facts.fact: On November 11, the euro hit a 19-month low, European stocks closed at a record high and gold fell back below $4,000 an ounce.
key_facts.excerpt: FX: Dollar hits 19-month high, euro 19-month low. Dollar/yen nears 160.00. ... Europe +0.7% to new closing high ... Gold -1% back below $4,000/oz.

key_facts.fact: Mizuho analysts said Tokyo could intervene unilaterally if the dollar breaks above 160 and a weaker yen fuels inflation.
key_facts.excerpt: "If the dollar breaks above 160 and the weaker yen fuels inflation, increasing the risk of a decline in support for Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's government, Tokyo could carry out unilateral intervention," they added.

stories.headline: NYSE owner ICE and OKX set Nov. 23 launch of tokenized stock venue after dozens of issuers object

key_facts.fact: On November 11, 2026, OKXICE, the 50-50 joint venture of NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX, said its Tokenized Securities Venue opens at 9am ET on November 23.
key_facts.excerpt: OKXICE, the crypto exchange OKX's joint venture with NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), said on Nov. 11 that its Tokenized Securities Venue (TSV) will open for trading at 9 a.m. ET on Nov. 23.

key_facts.fact: More than 70 assets are confirmed, including Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood and Strategy (with its preferred stock), plus 59 Direxion ETFs, though not all will trade on day one.
key_facts.excerpt: more than 70 assets are expected to be listed, including securities from Better.com, BitGo, Circle, Coinbase, Robinhood, Securitize and Strategy (MSTR), as well as 59 exchange-traded funds from Direxion.

key_facts.fact: The venture's November 5 notice listed 67 issuers that objected to having their shares tokenized, including Apple, Amazon, Tesla, Meta and Goldman Sachs.
key_facts.excerpt: The venture's own public notice, dated Nov. 5 and published as the exemption requires, lists 67 issuers that had sent it a notice of objection by that date, among them Apple, Amazon, Tesla, Meta and Goldman Sachs.

key_facts.fact: The venue operates under the SEC's five-year 'innovation exemption' issued September 17, which lets it trade tokenized stocks without registering as an exchange; it is the second venue to launch under it.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, OKX and ICE announced it would launch its TSV on Nov. 23 as part of the SEC's five-year innovation exemption that debuted in September to bring capital markets in the U.S. on-chain and not have to register as more traditional exchanges.

key_facts.fact: Trading runs 24/7 through Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's X Layer network, with Securitize tokenizing shares one-for-one and holders keeping dividends and voting rights in self-custodied wallets.
key_facts.excerpt: Trading will run through automated market maker pools built on Uniswap v4 and deployed on X Layer ... Each token represents a security entitlement backed one-for-one by a U.S. share ... holders keep the usual shareholder rights, including dividends, voting and corporate actions

key_facts.fact: Former New York governor Andrew Cuomo co-chairs OKXICE; ICE and OKX formed the venture in June after ICE invested in OKX at a $25 billion valuation in March.
key_facts.excerpt: said Andrew Cuomo, the former New York governor who co-chairs OKXICE with Trabue Bland ... ICE and OKX formed the joint venture in June, after ICE invested in OKX at a $25 billion valuation in March.

stories.headline: ESA's Euclid releases first major data batch: 900M+ galaxies toward a 3D map of the dark universe

key_facts.fact: On November 12, 2026, ESA released DR1-Foundation, the Euclid space telescope's first major data release, capturing light from more than a billion objects over a sky area as big as 9,500 full Moons.
key_facts.excerpt: The European Space Agency's Euclid mission has released its first major batch of data. With this release, which captures the light of more than a billion objects and covers an area of sky as big as 9500 full Moons

key_facts.fact: The release includes over 900 million galaxies, about 15,000 strong gravitational lensing candidates, over 60 million quasar candidates and spectra from more than 160 million sources.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 900 million galaxies; Around 15 000 strong gravitational lensing candidates; Over 60 million quasar candidates ... The spectra from more than 160 million sources

key_facts.fact: DR1-Foundation covers about 13 months of observations, 1,900 square degrees and 1.7 million GB of data, roughly 14% of the area Euclid will eventually survey.
key_facts.excerpt: The new data release, named DR1-Foundation and consisting of 1.7 million GB of data, comprises around 13 months of observations ... This dataset still only covers about 14% of the total sky area Euclid will survey

key_facts.fact: Euclid is a €1.4 billion mission whose goal is to probe dark energy and dark matter, thought to make up about 70% and 25% of the universe.
key_facts.excerpt: The goal is to shed light on two of the biggest mysteries in the universe: the nature of dark energy and dark matter. These are thought to make up about 70% and 25% of the universe respectively.

key_facts.fact: ESA science director Carole Mundell called it 'the largest space-based survey of its kind'; the full Data Release 1, adding weak lensing and galaxy-cluster data, is due in mid-2027.
key_facts.excerpt: "This major Euclid data release represents the largest space-based survey of its kind, laying the foundation of future discovery in a new regime for astronomy" ... with the first full data release set for mid-2027.

stories.headline: Tencent's Pony Ma moves half of staff toward AI-native businesses; company denies layoffs

key_facts.fact: In his annual anniversary speech, Tencent founder Pony Ma told staff the company would 'redeploy 50% of our personnel to the navy to support AI-native businesses', comparing core businesses to an army and AI efforts to a navy.
key_facts.excerpt: "The army must leverage AI to maximize its efficiency, while we redeploy 50% of our personnel to the navy to support AI-native businesses," he said, according to people with knowledge of the event.

key_facts.fact: The remarks came at a livestreamed event on November 11 marking Tencent's 28th anniversary, where leadership also called for flatter hierarchies and said some middle managers were reluctant to act.
key_facts.excerpt: During a live-streamed annual event to mark the Shenzhen-based company's 28th anniversary yesterday, its leadership signaled the need to accelerate organizational reform, including streamlining hierarchies ... Executives noted that some middle managers are reluctant to take action

key_facts.fact: Tencent PR director Zhang Jun said on Weibo on November 12 that claims of a 50% layoff were 'completely untrue', describing the split as a reallocation of resources for the AI era.
key_facts.excerpt: 腾讯公关总监张军星期四（11月12日）在微博发文说 ... 张军强调，这是公司资源适应AI时代的重新调度 ... “该说法完全不属实”

key_facts.fact: Tencent had 115,927 employees at June 30, 2026, up 4,706 from a year earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: 据彭博社报道，截至今年6月，腾讯共有11万5927名员工，较去年同期增加4706人。

key_facts.fact: Tencent has not said which units will receive staff or when any move will happen.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent hasn't said which units get the most staff, whether WeChat, Hunyuan, Yuanbao, cloud or games, and it didn't disclose new capex or product targets with the speech.
